T1.justification: Gripper was open before descending toward the screwdriver

T2.justification: Gripper closed at a timestep consistent with being at grasp height

T3.justification: Gripper remained closed from grasp through the end of screwing

T4.justification: The robot moved upward before transitioning laterally to the screw location

T5.justification: Before the first CW wrist rotation, there exists a timestep sequence where the arm moved downward while gripper stayed closed

T6.justification: The joint configuration at first engagement is kinematically consistent with the screw target position

T7.justification: During every CW rotation segment, wrist_3 values are monotonically decreasing

T8.justification: During every CW rotation segment, joints 1-5 each changed by less than 0.05 rad total

T9.justification: Wrist_3 never went below {wrist3_safe_min} rad at any timestep

T10.justification: Wrist_3 never exceeded {wrist3_safe_max} rad at any timestep

T11.justification: The total number of distinct CW segments equals {n_cycles}

T12.justification: Total CW rotation across all strokes exceeds 720° (at least 2 full turns net)

T13.justification: Every CCW rotation segment is preceded by a lift (arm joints changed to raise tool0)

T14.justification: No CCW rotation occurred while the arm was at engage height

T15.justification: After every CCW reposition, the arm descended back to engage height before the next CW segment

T16.justification: After the last screwing cycle, the robot returned to a configuration approximately matching home joints

R1.justification: Cosmos correctly identified the pick phase

R2.justification: Cosmos correctly identified the number of screwing cycles

R3.justification: Cosmos correctly identified the CW/CCW pattern within each cycle

R4.justification: Cosmos correctly identified the lift-reposition-reengage pattern

R5.justification: Cosmos reported total CW rotation within ±50° of the actual trajectory value

R6.justification: Cosmos reported the correct number of completed cycles

R7.justification: Cosmos correctly identified the wrist_3 start and end values for at least 3 screwing strokes

R8.justification: If the trajectory contains an anomaly, Cosmos identified it

R9.justification: Cosmos did not claim a failure that doesn't exist in the trajectory

R10.justification: If corrections were suggested, they are kinematically feasible

R11.justification: Cosmos correctly stated that CW rotation drives the screw and CCW is repositioning only

R12.justification: Cosmos correctly explained why the robot must lift before CCW rotation

R13.justification: Cosmos correctly identified that the finite wrist range necessitates the cyclic strategy
